source_refs.note: 3- Nicotine: a main subheading of 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 48-49.

blocks.text: Nicotine is a highly addictive drug found in tobacco products, including cigarettes, cigars, and smokeless tobacco. Its use leads to addiction and dependence, as well as a range of negative physical and mental health effects, including respiratory problems, cancers, cardiovascular disease, and mental health disorders.
